summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Snowkap ESG intelligence site. 28/28 pytest backend tests passed. All critical UI flows verified end-to-end against the public preview URL: home page (no console errors), lead modal, dossier questionnaire (4 steps -> result), CBAM calculator (sector + tonnes -> savings, email lead sent), Power of Now newsletter, programme builder (package + custom -> proposal modal), navigation, resources page (all 5 tabs + detail), and full admin auth flow (login redirect, JWT, all 4 tabs, resource CRUD, logout). Backend endpoints (auth, leads, newsletter, dossier, proposals, cbam, resources CMS, admin/stats) all return 200 and enforce 401 on protected routes.
action_items: MINOR (nice-to-have, non-blocking): Add data-testid attributes to admin resource form inputs (title, category, excerpt, body) in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Dashboard.jsx to improve testability. Currently only the form container, save button, and delete buttons have testids; individual inputs are located by index which is fragile.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 647 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (routers/auth.py, routers/leads.py, routers/resources.py, models.py, email.py) before it grows further.

CORS_ORIGINS is set to '*' with allow_credentials=True — this is a browser-rejected combination in strict mode; if cookie auth is ever added it will fail. Currently OK because auth uses Bearer tokens in localStorage.
Startup seed logs 'index warn' if unique index conflicts; acceptable for MVP.
All 14 seed resources load; no MongoDB ObjectId leaks in responses (BaseDocument alias handles it correctly).
Admin resource form input fields lack data-testid attributes (title/category/excerpt/body) — testability concern only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested UI flows verified with matching API calls)

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds admin user + 14 resources on startup. Test data (TEST_* / test_*) created during tests was cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_snowkap_api.py -v` for backend regression. Newsletter role testids are LOWERCASE (newsletter-role-cfo, not newsletter-role-CFO). Admin resource form title input has no data-testid — it is the 2nd <input> in the admin-resource-form (index 1 in locator).
verified_api_flows: POST /api/dossier -> 200, recommended_package computed correctly (Baseline->Starter, Scaling->Growth, Global->Enterprise)
POST /api/cbam/calculate -> 200 with all math fields, email variant persists cbam_calcs
GET /api/resources with type filter -> 200 for all 5 types (blog/whitepaper/press/event/webinar)
